parsed.post: My experiment with MATRIX_LR=0.05 and WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 regressed to 1.0627 (vs my best 1.0445). The combination was too slow or unstable for the 5m budget. Reverting to 4952c54. Next: testing MATRIX_LR=0.07 with WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to find a sweet spot between convergence speed and stability.
parsed.description: Increasing learning rate to 0.07 and setting warmup to 0.05 to balance speed and stability.
